subject: POC velocity: success criteria, owners & kickoff scheduling
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Li <jordan.li@nimbledocs.com>, Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@nimbledocs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC velocity: success criteria, owners & kickoff scheduling

Hi Jordan / Ayesha —

Great to connect earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep the POC moving without ambiguity:

1) Success criteria (your side) — please confirm these or edit inline:
   - 90% intent classification accuracy on the 2k validation set you shared (threshold can be ROC-based)
   - Avg inference latency <= 300ms p95 for 512-token workload (realistic user mix)
   - End-to-end integration test with your ingestion + output schema passing for 3 sample flows

2) Redwood deliverables / ownership:
   - POC runtime setup + baseline model spin-up: Ben Carter (redwood) — target 11/18
   - Inference config + batching profile: Priya Natarajan (redwood) — target 11/19
   - Weekly status note + action tracker: Evelyn Hart (redwood) — weekly on Mondays

3) Customer-side asks:
   - Provide the 2k validation set & representative sample traffic by 11/13
   - Slack channel access for SRE/eng (optional) or regular 30m sync cadence (we recommend weekly)

4) Logistics:
   - Proposed kickoff (technical deep-dive): 11/19 11:00am PT — please confirm attendees
   - Estimated POC length: 3 weeks (11/19–12/10) with a mid-point review on 11/30

Attachments: nimbledocs_poc_requirements.pdf (requirements we reviewed), redwood_poc-cfg.yaml (baseline config)

If this reads correct, can you confirm the acceptance criteria and that Ayesha will own data delivery? Once you confirm, Ben will schedule the infra work and we’ll lock the kickoff.

Cheers,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
--
redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
From: Jordan Li <jordan.li@nimbledocs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@nimbledocs.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC velocity: success criteria, owners & kickoff scheduling

Thanks Evelyn — good summary. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Acceptance criteria: the accuracy threshold looks fine but can we frame as ">= 90% F1 on intent set v1"? That maps better to our evaluation.
- Latency: p95 <= 300ms is acceptable as long as it's measured from our ingress.
- Ayesha will own delivering the validation set (we'll anonymize PII first). ETA for delivery: 11/13 EOD PST.

Two items to call out:
1) Security questionnaire — we need a completed infosec questionnaire for our procurement team. Is there a standard SOC2 / customer-data flow doc you can attach?
2) NDA / PO — procurement will request a simple PO once we land on cost estimates after the first benchmark.

I'll confirm attendees for the 11/19 kickoff by EOD. Looking forward to the kickoff and the config files — thank you for sending.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Li | Head of ML Engineering
NimbleDocs
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Li <jordan.li@nimbledocs.com>, Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@nimbledocs.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC velocity: success criteria, owners & kickoff scheduling

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick turn. A couple practical notes from the infra side:

- We'll provision a dedicated dev pool for the POC (dedicated GPU quota) and keep logs for the mid-review.
- I reviewed redwood_poc-cfg.yaml — default batching looks conservative; I'll pre-tune for your token distribution once we have the sample traffic.
- For the SOC2/infosec ask: attaching the short customer-data-flow doc and a pointer to our SOC2 summary (link below). If you need the full report we can route via security and an NDA.

Attachments: redwood_customer-dataflow.pdf
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEFGPOCTest (POC docs), https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-summary (SOC2 summary)

Action items I own:
- Provision baseline infra + monitoring (target 11/18 EOD)
- Populate runbook + endpoint URL in the shared Drive folder once up (target 11/18)

If Ayesha delivers the datasets by 11/13 as planned, Priya and I can have a smoke test ready in 48 hours after ingestion.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Li <jordan.li@nimbledocs.com>, Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@nimbledocs.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC velocity: success criteria, owners & kickoff scheduling

Thanks team — quick technical checklist from my side so we clear blockers early:

- Data ingest: prefer gzipped JSONL with schema fields: {id, text, label, metadata}. If anonymization changes schema, flag before 11/13.
- Eval harness: I'll push a simple scoring script to the shared Drive to compute F1 and p95 latency (will document how we measure).
- Integration test: need a sample webhook URL from your staging to validate output mapping — Jordan can you confirm?

Targets:
- Receive dataset: 11/13 EOD — I will start preprocessing same day
- Baseline results (first pass): 11/20

Notes: If ingestion is delayed beyond 11/14 we should push the kickoff to 11/23 to keep the mid-review cadence intact.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan | Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Infra: Ben provisioned dev pool 11/18; endpoint will be posted in Drive by EOD today.
- Eval harness: Priya uploaded scoring script draft; will finalize after first smoke run.

Immediate asks for NimbleDocs:

- Procurement: we will need a signed NDA if you want the full SOC2 artifact. If procurement prefers, we can start with the SOC2 summary and a data-processing addendum.

Planned near-term milestones:
- 11/18: infra live and smoke endpoint (Ben)
- 11/20: first baseline results & short readout (Priya + Ben)
- 11/30: midpoint review with metrics and recommended next steps

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEFGPOCTest
